# `select_mount_list_index`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Choose the active primary or auxiliary mount from the device mount list.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider handler @0x7bec0 (64-bit build) |

Refused with 312 while the relevant equipment is connected. Otherwise replaces the active mount selection (primary or auxiliary) through the equipment dialog logic. Mount-list membership and persistence of the choice are unresolved. Via the imager command port (4700) the request reaches this handler only as a forwarded unknown method; see the control service for the relay.

Side effects: Replaces the active primary or auxiliary mount selection.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"select_mount_list_index"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object\|array | yes | - | Object {index, aux} or the positional array [index, aux]. With aux absent or not a string the primary mount list is addressed and index MUST be an integer (104 otherwise). With aux exactly "aux" the auxiliary list is addressed and index may be an integer or a string (a name); any other type gives 109. Any other string for aux gives 109. No numeric clamp; choice-list bounds are checked natively (209). [READ] |
| `params.index` | integer\|string | yes | - | Index into the mount list (integer), or for the auxiliary list also a name. [READ] |
| `params.aux` | string | no | - | The literal "aux" selects the auxiliary mount list; omit to select the primary list. Any other string gives 109. [READ] |

| `Timestamp` | string | no | - | (both) Decimal string `<seconds>.<nanoseconds>` with exactly nine fractional digits, formatted with `%ld.%09ld` from clock_gettime clock id 1. Linux clock id 1 is CLOCK_MONOTONIC, so the value is monotonic time, not wall-clock or Unix time (INFERRED from the clock id). ## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 104 | Primary selection with a non-integer index | `expected int param` |
| 109 | aux is a string other than "aux", or the auxiliary index is neither integer nor string | `unexpected param` |
| 209 | Index or name not found in the choice list | `invalid value` |
| 312 | Relevant equipment is connected | `cannot select if equipment are connected` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request is not an object, is an empty object, or has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: no method of type string (a non-string method counts as missing) | `invalid request` |
| 101 | Dispatcher: text fails to parse | `invalid JSON request: <reason> on line <n> ...` |
| 103 | Dispatcher: unregistered method | `method not found` |

## Example

Request, request - Example request (values invented):

```json
{"id":47,"method":"select_mount_list_index","params":{"index":1}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"select_mount_list_index","result":0,"code":0,"id":47}
```

Reply, error:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"select_mount_list_index","error":"cannot select if equipment are connected","code":312,"id":48}
```
